properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 1 at 2:45PM AKST until November 1 at 5:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...South winds 15 to 20 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Ketchikan Gateway Borough.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM AKST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.
